title: The Subtle Art of Not Giving a F*ck
author: Mark Manson
blurb: Choose better values — and fewer fake priorities.
description: Manson’s point isn’t apathy — it’s triage. You only have so many cares to give, so spend them on what actually matters and accept the pain that comes with good values. Blunt, funny, and useful when endless positivity has stopped helping and you need permission to stop chasing everything.
